title: Oven-Glazed Indian Lentil Curry
description: Jammy, shattering one-pot Indian dish featuring vanilla bean paste, lardons, low-fat friendly.
instructions: In a large oven-safe pot, heat bacon lardons over medium until crisp, then remove and set aside on paper towel.
Add diced onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the bacon fat and sauté until onion is translucent.
Stir in ground cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, garam masala, and red chili flakes, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add tomato paste, canned diced tomatoes, and vanilla bean paste; stir to combine.
Rinse the lentils and add them to the pot, followed by 500ml water and a pinch of salt; stir well.
Bring mixture to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until lentils are almost tender.
Transfer pot to preheated oven and bake uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring midway, until sauce thickens and lentils are fully cooked.
Return pot to stove, stir in crisp bacon lardons, adjust seasoning with salt if needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and a splash of lemon juice for brightness.
